title: Error Headcount
story: The release lead needs one number before deciding whether to roll back. The deployment log mixes routine messages, warnings, and actual errors.
objective: Print the number of lines containing ERROR in /srv/deploy/deploy.log.
hints: grep ERROR deploy.log prints only matching lines.
wc -l counts input lines; grep also has a count option.
explanation: A pipeline can filter records with grep and count them with wc -l. For a single file, grep -c is a shorter route to the same observable result.

files.content:
INFO release started
ERROR image unavailable
WARN using cached metadata
ERROR health check failed
INFO retry started
ERROR rollback required
